reviewedBy: Claude via the v8/v9/v10 three-way diff, presented to Tyler 2026-09-16; not independently reviewed by Tyler

base.rationale: We compare options online to get a comfortable mattress at our budget with the right firmness, solid reviews, and an easy home trial/return.

scenarios.label: Couple main-bed upgrade
scenarios.description: Replacing a worn queen/king used nightly, researched online and bought for comfort and durability.

scenarios.label: Solo first setup
scenarios.description: One person furnishing a first apartment on a budget with fast delivery and simple setup.

scenarios.label: Back-pain relief pick
scenarios.description: Buying to address back/neck pain, prioritizing support, zoning, and firmness choice.

scenarios.label: Holiday deal hunt
scenarios.description: Timing purchase for Memorial Day/Black Friday to maximize discounts on a mid-tier model.

cellTexts: [problem_recognition|Couple main-bed upgrade|generic] we're not sleeping well. there's a dip in the middle so we roll into each other, and every time my partner moves it wakes me up. hips ache, shoulders go numb, and it gets hot. what could actually fix this for both of us?

[problem_recognition|Solo first setup|generic] setting up my first place - been sleeping on a stopgap and my shoulders hate me. i'm picky: want support without that stuck-in-the-mud feel, cooler nights, no weird chemical smell, clean look. what should i be aiming for to get real sleep?

[problem_recognition|Back-pain relief pick|generic] lower back is angry every morning, worse after side sleeping. i need a way to keep my spine neutral without feeling like i'm on a rock. what should i change so this stops?

[problem_recognition|Holiday deal hunt|generic] trying to use holiday sales to finally fix my awful sleep. budget about 1200, need cooler nights and way better support, and it has to arrive fast. what should i watch for so i don't blow the sale window?
[category_education|-|generic] basic question: what does a mattress actually do besides soft vs firm? how is it supposed to support you and keep you comfortable?

[discovery|Couple main-bed upgrade|generic] best mattress for couples who like different firmness levels? need strong motion isolation, good edge support, sleeps cool, king size, around 2k. what should be on my radar?

[discovery|Solo first setup|generic] first place, being picky: best mattress for a 150 lb solo sleeper, medium-firm, neutral (not sinky), breathable, low off-gassing, solid value under 1200, and holds up over time?

[discovery|Back-pain relief pick|generic] best mattress for lower-back pain that keeps hips from sagging, gives pressure relief for side sleeping, and doesn't sleep hot. budget up to 1800. what should I look at?

[discovery|Holiday deal hunt|generic] holiday sale targets: what are the best mattresses actually worth grabbing on Black Friday/Cyber Monday? want reliable build, easy returns, quick shipping, queen or king.
[shortlist|Couple main-bed upgrade|generic] can you shortlist 3-4 mattresses for couples with different firmness needs? priorities: motion isolation, cooling, sturdy edges, king size, under 2k.

[shortlist|Solo first setup|generic] first apartment setup: give me 3 smart mattress picks with a medium-firm, balanced feel, breathable, low-VOC, good trial/warranty, under 1200 for a 150 lb solo sleeper.

[shortlist|Back-pain relief pick|generic] i need 3 mattresses that actually help with back pain for a 180 lb side sleeper - keeps lumbar supported, good shoulder relief, not too soft, doesn't run hot. under 1500.
[shortlist|Holiday deal hunt|generic] black friday shortlist: 3 mattresses worth grabbing if the price drops - solid quality, easy returns, quick shipping. aiming for queen under 1000 if possible.

[criteria|Couple main-bed upgrade|generic] We're replacing our main bed as a couple. Different sleep temps, I'm a side sleeper, he's back, and we share with a cat. What should we actually look for so it works for both of us?

[criteria|Solo first setup|generic] first time buying for myself. I want to decide on feel and design with a clear head, not hype. I sleep alone, like a slightly buoyant medium feel, and care about materials and longevity. How should I weigh firmness, construction, durability, and price?
[criteria|Back-pain relief pick|generic] Chronic lower back tightness, 180 lb combo sleeper. What matters most in a mattress to help with alignment and morning stiffness, and what should I avoid?
[criteria|Holiday deal hunt|generic] Holiday mattress sales everywhere. How do I spot a real deal vs fake MSRP slashes, and which specs and policies should matter more than the discount percent?

[use_case|Couple main-bed upgrade|generic] Our queen is done. We need strong motion isolation, solid edges for sitting, not too hot, minimal off-gassing. Budget about 1500, open to foam or hybrid. What would you point us toward for a shared main bed?

[use_case|Solo first setup|generic] new studio, slatted platform, I read and work in bed sometimes. Prefer medium-firm with a little bounce, sensitive to smells, want a clean look without a super tall profile. What should I get and what thickness makes sense?

[use_case|Back-pain relief pick|generic] Desk job and mild sciatica. Waking up sore on an old spring mattress. Mostly side sleeper, sometimes back. Want supportive but pressure relieving under 2k. How should I narrow and test options?

[use_case|Holiday deal hunt|generic] Trying to snag a king over the holidays. Flexible on brand, want a solid warranty, easy returns, and real savings not fluff. Can you help me time it and spot which bundles are actually worth it?

[social_validation|-|generic] Where do real owners talk about their mattresses, and which options have been rating consistently high lately for side sleepers and hot sleepers? Looking for credible review sources and patterns, not ads.

[comparison|Couple main-bed upgrade|Casper] Couple upgrading our main bed: Purple vs Casper, which one handles motion transfer and edge support better, and which sleeps cooler? Any durability differences we should know about?

[comparison|Solo first setup|Tempur-Pedic] I love the slow, contouring feel of Tempur-Pedic but I'm price sensitive. How does Purple compare on pressure relief, spinal alignment, off-gassing, and long-term durability for a solo sleeper who cares a lot about feel?

[comparison|Back-pain relief pick|Serta] Lower back pain, 190 lb combo sleeper. Between Purple and Serta, which lines do better for lumbar support and keeping the spine neutral? Any firmness starting points you'd suggest?

[comparison|Holiday deal hunt|Sealy] Holiday shopping: Purple vs Sealy, who usually runs the better promos on queen or king, and are the add-ons like pillows or bases actually valuable or just padding the deal?

[objections|Couple main-bed upgrade|generic] We're replacing our queen and looking at Purple. How does it actually hold up for two people long term: motion transfer, edge support, does it dip in the middle?

[objections|Solo first setup|generic] first mattress on my own. i like a bouncier, responsive feel, not that slow sink. does Purple keep spinal alignment and stay cool, or is that grid just marketing?

[objections|Back-pain relief pick|generic] Chronic low back pain here. Will Purple really keep me in neutral and resist sagging after a year or two? Any real difference between their models for lumbar support?
[objections|Holiday deal hunt|generic] Black Friday shopping. Are Purple doorbuster models the same build or watered down? I don't want a sale version that sleeps hot or breaks down fast.

[pricing|Couple main-bed upgrade|generic] What's a fair price range for a durable king that keeps partner movement down? And for Purple specifically, how do the entry vs higher-end models compare on value once you add delivery, base, and returns?

[pricing|Solo first setup|generic] i'm budgeting carefully. for a full-size, where's the value sweet spot online under 1000 vs 1500? if i went with Purple, which tier has the best cost-to-performance for a lighter sleeper, and are trial and returns truly free?

[pricing|Back-pain relief pick|generic] If the goal is back-pain relief, does paying more actually buy better support or just extras? With Purple, which model level gives the best support per dollar, and do I need to budget for a specific base?

[pricing|Holiday deal hunt|generic] Holiday promos make everything look half off. What's a realistic out the door price for a Purple queen after promos, including any fees for shipping, returns, or old mattress removal? Or are there better value windows than Black Friday?

[churn_triggers|-|generic] I've been on a Purple for 3 years. Edges feel softer now and my hips sink more. Do I try a topper, rotate it, or is it time to switch? Would a firmer Purple model actually fix this?
[alternatives|-|defensive] Looking at Purple but want to see what else is similar before I buy. What mattresses feel close and are worth a look?
[alternatives|-|Casper] If I skip Casper, what other online beds in that mid-price range should I consider for a combo sleeper?
[alternatives|-|Tempur-Pedic] Tempur-Pedic is out of my budget. What has a similar slow-sink, pressure relief feel without the sticker shock?
[alternatives|-|Serta] Not sold on Serta. Who makes comparable mattresses that hold up better?
[alternatives|-|Sealy] sealy alternatives for a side sleeper with shoulder pain? prefer something that doesn't trap heat.

[problem_resolution|-|generic] My Purple mattress has a dip forming where I sleep after about 9 months. How do I tell if it qualifies for a warranty claim and what should I do right now to fix or slow it? pics, measurements, base check?

[expansion|-|generic] We love our Purple in the primary bedroom. Thinking of getting another for the guest room and maybe a kid's twin. Which model would you pick for each, or is it fine to just get the same one we have?

[ecosystem|-|generic] What bed frames and accessories pair best with a Purple mattress? slat spacing, box spring or not, adjustable base that fits, sheets that won't make it feel stiff, protector that won't trap heat?

[advocacy|-|generic] Friend says Purple is a gimmick. I actually sleep great on mine. How do I explain the feel and benefits to them without sounding salesy, and what legit sources or comparisons can I point to?
